column1: # Kegare, the Mia-mimicking Water Adept, in Tolbi.

column3: At last. I've watched you\nprotect her, and now I can\nsee what she sees in you.{end_wait}
You look exactly like Mia.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

I've studied her voice,
her movements, and the
way they trust her.{page_break}Imitation was only the
beginning. I intend to
take her place.{end_wait}
Mia is not a place for you\nto take. You'll have to get\nthrough us first.{end_wait}
